def: A CLIP-style image-text pretraining method that replaces the batch-wide softmax contrastive loss with an independent sigmoid loss on each image-text pair.
practice: Needing no batch-wide normalization makes large batches cheaper and small batches work better; as of November 2026, SigLIP and SigLIP 2 encoders are common vision towers in open VLMs such as PaliGemma.
